posts.text: The whole world wanted peace. Israel wanted war. Guess who got their way? But the clownish liars posing as journalists in US media will say it's all a coincidence that Israel got what they wanted again. No, Israel obviously controls this country. People denying that are a joke.

We have started bombing Iran again. We claim it's in self-defense, even though the Iranians didn't fire at us. Israelis have taught us well. Meanwhile, Israel is pummeling Lebanon. In the deal, Israel wants the right to keep bombing Lebanon but for Lebanon not to defend itself.

Congrats to Israel, they killed another peace deal. We were at 95% done. After Puppet Trump talked to Netanyahu, he came out with new completely unrealistic demands:

1. Israel doesn't have to abide by the peace deal and can keep attacking Lebanon. So, only a ceasefire for one side.
2. We have to take out all the enriched uranium on day one, not in the second stage.
3. All Middle Eastern countries have to betray the Palestinians and sign Abraham Accords to normalize relations with Israel without

Why are we on the side of the terrorists? Israel has literally killed 100 times the number of civilians Hamas and Hezbollah have. They kill civilians at a greater rate than any terrorist group. They want endless war in Middle East and take more land for their empire in each war.

Americans and Iranians are almost completely agreed on a peace deal, but the Israelis don't agree. Iran wants peace deal to cover whole region. Israel doesn't agree, they want the right to keep murdering the Lebanese and taking their land. And to take more of Gaza and West Bank.

Everyone making the case for more war now is an Israeli asset. 

Yes, there are that many.

Since our media are liars who work for Israel, they never tell you what Abraham Accords actually are. It's a promise by Arab countries to betray the Palestinians, allow the Israelis to permanently occupy them and take their land. In return, those countries get economic benefits.

And what’s hilarious is that in mainstream media they’re in fantasyland, where Trump is just randomly changing his mind every time after Netanyahu calls him because he’s indecisive or Netanyahu is so persuasive. Yeah, that’s probably it. They say with a straight face.

God damn it, Israel got a week long delay and Trump is back to unreasonable demands on the uranium. We just can’t shake these guys. Literally everyone else on planet earth wanted this deal. Israel must have some thermonuclear blackmail.

If Israel wants to keep the war going, they can do it on their own. They’re demanding not only that the war continue, but that we fight it for them. We have no such obligation. They should stop too, but that’s their mistake to make. We have ZERO RESPONSIBILITY to Israel.

This is not what the deal is at all. Netanyahu is trying to reset the deal so that it becomes impossible. Iranians never agreed to let Israel keep attacking Lebanon or to remove all of the uranium. He’s lying to drag us back into war. Ignore the lying, weasely, warmonger.


Benjamin Netanyahu - בנימין נתניהו (@netanyahu)

I spoke last night with President @realDonaldTrump about the memorandum of understanding to reopen the Straits of Hormuz and the upcoming negotiations toward a final agreement

Let's get to peace! Let's get out of there. Let's stop ruining our economy for no reason. Let's stop listening to Israel - they hate this deal and don't want us to do it. This is definitely a good enough deal for us. When you're in a hole Israel put you in, stop digging!

I get why the neocons are calling this peace a deal a surrender by Trump. They want to pressure him to continue this disastrous war. Don't help them! If you're against the war, calling it surrender isn't helping. We have to do a deal, Iran has more leverage. This is good enough.

Government apparently sent some bullshit subpoena to @hasanthehun. They're tightening the noose on speech. Remember, they'll always have an excuse or some technicality. It's not like they're going to tell you, "We did it because we don't like what you're saying (about Israel)."
So, in a remarkable coincidence, just as it's announced that we are at the doorstep of a peace deal, someone happens to take shots at the White House at that same exact time.

Potential peace deal is real! Israel hates it! That means it has a real chance at getting us to peace. They hate peace overall and the idea that we wouldn't fight their wars for them. They'll try to kill this now, but if we survive their political assault, we could get to peace.
